title: University of Arkansas Extension — Homeowner's Guide to Pruning Ornamental Trees (FSA6149)

common.preserved_uncertainty: General shrub text; same institution as UAEX, so not independent of it.

content.identity: University of Arkansas Cooperative Extension, James A. Robbins, "Homeowner's Guide to Pruning Ornamental Trees" (FSA6149, Aug 2017; recorded in the FRD under the incorrect title "Pruning Landscape Trees and Shrubs"); FRD code UAEXFSA; web address <https://www.uaex.uada.edu/publications/pdf/FSA-6149.pdf>, accessed 29 September 2026. As recorded in `FRD-BUSHROSE-STEMCROSSING-02` §4
content.relevance: Defines a removal cut ("removes a branch back to its point of origin") and separately lists crossing branches as a structural problem. It does not itself connect the two (Source Register addendum §3.2).

provenance.note: Initial LIL load: gardener-facing content transcribed from the Published submission package (Founder Review Rendering). Earlier versions are preserved in git history of that package.
